offers.eligibility: Walmart+ membership + linked Royal Perks account required
offers.title: 25% off your digital order
offers.terms: Once daily at participating U.S. locations. Activate in Offers first. Before tax and fees; not combinable with other offers or discounted meals. Excludes AK, HI and U.S. territories. Delivery fees apply.
steps: You need an active Walmart+ membership (paid) - without it this offer isn't available.
In the Walmart app: open your Walmart+ Benefits hub and tap the Burger King Savings tile.
Tap Get Started and link your free BK Royal Perks account.
Open the BK app, sign in to Royal Perks, go to the Offers tab and tap the coupon.
Add it to a mobile order and check out.

offers.title: Free chips & guac with $5+ purchase
offers.eligibility: Eligible new Rewards members; digital reward must be in your account
offers.terms: One-time signup reward; use within 7 days after it is added. $5 minimum before tax and tip. Order Chips & Guacamole as a complete side. Participating locations; not combinable or valid on third-party delivery. Also redeemable in restaurant.
offers.evidence: Eligible members receive one free topping or regular side of guac and one regular side of chips with a purchase of $5.00 or more
steps: Get the Chipotle app and join Chipotle Rewards (free).
Place an order of $5 or more (before tax/tip).
The free Chips & Guac reward lands in your account within 24-48h - find it under Rewards.
Use it within 7 days: order Chips & Guacamole as one complete side item.
